subject.title: feat(macos): redesign chat window as native shell with sessions sidebar, toolbar pickers, slash commands, and context usage

question: Should OpenClaw accept this broad native macOS chat shell as the direction for #101086, or split the work down to narrower transport/session parity fixes first?
rationale: Source review can verify the existing gateway contracts, but the scope, visual design, and workflow parity target are product choices for a maintainer-labeled macOS redesign.

options.title: Accept shell after proof and rebase
options.body: Proceed with the native shell direction once conflicts are resolved, CI is green, and redacted macOS screenshots or recording/log proof are attached.

options.title: Split transport parity first
options.body: Land only sessions.create, commands.list, and session action plumbing now, leaving the large shell redesign for a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Defer the redesign
options.body: Keep #101086 open and pause or close this PR if the native shell scope is too broad for core at this time.

recommendation.title: Accept shell after proof and rebase
recommendation.body: Proceed with the native shell direction once conflicts are resolved, CI is green, and redacted macOS screenshots or recording/log proof are attached.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the PR and has recent merged history in the same Mac/shared chat surface.
